voice_welcome: Hello, let us begin today's memory games!
voice_start_game: Start game. Take your time, there is no hurry.
voice_well_done: Wonderful effort! You did great today.
voice_reminder_alert: Reminder: It is time for your medication.
select_language_subtitle: Covering all 8 North Eastern States, Hindi & English
hero_desc: Smitri_NER is an AI-powered cognitive care platform designed to support elderly users through memory games, cognitive activities, personalized assistance, and caregiver support.
section_features_subtitle: Designed specifically for elderly ease of use, with large touch targets, voice guidance, and non-intrusive caregiver monitoring.
feature_games_desc: Interactive games that tune difficulty automatically to keep tasks calm and rewarding.
feature_reminders_desc: Large, high-contrast checklists for medication, hydration, and doctor visits, readable aloud via voice with a single tap.
feature_caregiver_desc: Family members and companions receive proactive alerts if a 3-day performance shift or missed routine is detected.
how_it_works_subtitle: A continuous loop of gentle interaction, objective rhythm tracking, and caring support.
step1_desc: Elderly users interact through high-contrast buttons, touch-friendly grids, and voice prompts.
step2_desc: Short, 2-minute memory challenges measure response speed, accuracy, and mistake recovery.
step3_desc: Our rule-based engine dynamically scales grid size and speed so users never feel pressured.
step4_desc: Caregivers see real-time trends and receive gentle notifications if check-ins are needed.
about_title: Bridging Care Across Remote & Rural Communities
about_desc: Smitri_NER is tailored to bridge the geographical challenges of the North Eastern Region. By supporting lightweight offline-friendly execution and multi-dialect voice assistance, families stay closely connected regardless of distance.
about_pillar1_desc: Works reliably on local device storage even during intermittent connectivity.
about_pillar2_desc: Single-click native cellular dial to local family or ambulance dispatch.
about_pillar3_desc: Structured data models mapped for upcoming ABDM & HL7 FHIR telehealth exchange.
blog_article1_title: How 7 Hours of Sleep Protects Neural Recall in Seniors
blog_article1_desc: Simple evening routines to promote deeper, memory-consolidating sleep cycles.
blog_article2_title: Why Water Intake Directly Affects Attention & Reaction Time
blog_article2_desc: Mild dehydration is one of the most common causes of morning cognitive fog.
blog_article3_title: Comforting Communication: Encouraging Daily Mental Games
blog_article3_desc: How family members can make daily cognitive check-ins playful and stress-free.
footer_copyright: © 2026 Smitri_NER Platform. Prototype cognitive wellness system. Not intended for clinical diagnosis.
modal_demo_subtitle: Experience the complete live workflow designed for seniors:
games_subtitle: Gentle, clinically inspired exercises designed to keep your mind sharp and active.
game_memory_match_desc: Tap two cards to find matching pairs of fruits and flowers.
game_sequence_memory_desc: Watch the light pattern, then tap the tiles in the exact same order.
game_different_one_desc: Spot the one symbol that does not belong with the others.
game_grocery_basket_desc: Remember daily market items and recall them into your basket.
game_number_trail_desc: Connect numbers in ascending order from 1 onwards.
game_pattern_match_desc: Recall which grid squares were illuminated.
game_sound_word_desc: Listen to the familiar sound and tap the matching picture.
game_clock_reading_desc: Read the clock hands and match the correct daily routine time.
game_rhyme_completion_desc: Complete classic comforting phrases and folk proverbs.
emergency_reassurance: Tap once to call your family. You are always safe.
offline_badge: Offline Mode Active (Data safely saved on this device)

features_step2_b3_desc: Encourages steady healthy routines every day.

features_step5_b1_desc: Memory games and reminders work without Wi-Fi or data.
